CustomField.description: Enables authorized troubleshooting details on the card and in the browser console. A user sees those details only when this field is checked and the user is directly assigned the Record Health Check Admin or Record Health Check Diagnostics Viewer Permission Set. Other users continue to see the standard card. Enable it only while diagnosing a configuration or evaluation problem.
CustomField.label: Show Diagnostics
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Troubleshooting only. Details appear only to users assigned Record Health Check Admin or Diagnostics Viewer. Leave unchecked during normal use.
